results.title: Regulatory announcement no 27: Share buyback
results.description: On October 28, 2026, InstallatørGruppen A/S (”InstallatørGruppen”) launched a share buyback program. Under this program, which will run from November 2, 2026, through March 31, 2027, InstallatørGruppen intends to repurchase shares for a total maximum consideration of up to DKK 25 million.

results.title: Forex reserves rise $2.49 billion to $719.55 billion, first weekly increase since September 4
results.description: Gold price gains and revaluation of foreign currency assets lifted India's foreign exchange reserves in the week ended November 6, even as the RBI continued to sell dollars to support the rupee.
